mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_claim(claim_code,knowledge_base_id,subject,predicate,object_value,condition_json,qualifier_json,polarity,confidence,certainty,status,permission_tags,valid_from,valid_to,version,claim_fingerprint,dedup_key)VALUES(#{claimCode},#{knowledgeBaseId},#{subject},#{predicate},#{objectValue},CAST(#{conditionJson} AS JSON),CAST(#{qualifierJson} AS JSON),#{polarity},#{confidence},#{certainty},#{status},CAST(#{permissionTags} AS JSON),#{validFrom},#{validTo},#{version},#{claimFingerprint},#{dedupKey})

INSERT IGNORE INTO t_knowledge_evidence(knowledge_code,evidence_id,support_type,support_score) SELECT #{knowledgeCode},e.id,'SUPPORT',0.80 FROM t_evidence e JOIN t_content_unit cu ON cu.id=e.content_unit_id WHERE cu.document_id=#{documentId}

INSERT IGNORE INTO t_claim_evidence(claim_code,evidence_id,support_type,support_score) SELECT #{claimCode},e.id,'SUPPORT',0.80 FROM t_evidence e JOIN t_content_unit cu ON cu.id=e.content_unit_id WHERE cu.document_id=#{documentId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_knowledge_card WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND (permission_tags IS NULL OR JSON_LENGTH(permission_tags)=0 OR JSON_CONTAINS(permission_tags, JSON_QUOTE(#{tag}))) AND (permission_tags IS NULL OR JSON_LENGTH(permission_tags)=0) ORDER BY updated_time DESC

SELECT * FROM t_claim WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND (permission_tags IS NULL OR JSON_LENGTH(permission_tags)=0 OR JSON_CONTAINS(permission_tags, JSON_QUOTE(#{tag}))) AND (permission_tags IS NULL OR JSON_LENGTH(permission_tags)=0) ORDER BY updated_time DESC
SELECT knowledge_code FROM t_knowledge_card WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND dedup_key=#{dedupKey} LIMIT 1

SELECT knowledge_code AS code, CAST(IFNULL(permission_tags,'') AS CHAR) AS permissionTags FROM t_knowledge_card WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND content_fingerprint=#{fingerprint} AND knowledge_code<>#{selfCode} LIMIT 20
SELECT claim_code FROM t_claim WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND dedup_key=#{dedupKey} LIMIT 1
SELECT e.id FROM t_evidence e WHERE e.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND e.evidence_code IN #{code} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_content_unit cu WHERE cu.id=e.content_unit_id AND cu.document_id=#{documentId})
